verdict.rationale: Neon documents slow-query listing and database inspection, but only through agent and CLI tooling, not a built-in insights view. The hosted MCP server exposes `list_slow_queries` and `inspect_database`, and `neon inspect db` runs 15 read-only checks covering unused indexes, stalled queries, cache hit rate, bloat and table/index sizes. Query optimization is also offered via the AI SQL Editor and Copilot agents. Missing for 10: a documented console insights dashboard, true index recommendations (only unused-index detection is evidenced), time-series performance metrics, and independent hands-on corroboration.
